{{Current events|year=2025|month=05|day=6|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[May 2025 Israeli attacks on Yemen]]
***[[Israel]]i airstrikes hit [[Sanaa International Airport]] in [[Sanaa]], [[Yemen]], and destroy three of [[Yemenia]]'s seven planes. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/sanaa-airport-official-says-facility-completely-destroyed-by-israeli-strikes/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[United States attacks in Yemen (March 2025–present)|United States attacks in Yemen]]
***[[U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that the [[United States]] has reached a ceasefire with the [[Houthis]], with [[Oman]] as mediator, and will stop its airstrikes, after they agreed to stop disrupting international shipping. [https://www.reuters.com/world/trump-says-us-will-stop-bombing-houthis-after-agreement-struck-2025-05-06/ (Reuters)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/world/yemen/oman-says-mediated-ceasefire-us-yemens-houthis-rcna205175 (NBC News)]
***A second [[U.S. Navy]] [[Boeing F/A-18E/F Super Hornet|F/A-18]] [[fighter jet]] is lost in the [[Red Sea]], due to an equipment failure during its attempted landing on {{USS|Harry Truman||}}. Both of its crew members ejected and were recovered. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/05/06/politics/second-us-navy-jet-is-lost-at-sea (CNN)]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**Seven [[Pakistan Army]] soldiers are killed and five others are injured when their vehicle in a convoy heading to a security operation is exploded by a [[Balochistan Liberation Army]] [[improvised explosive device]] in [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/6/pakistan-blames-india-after-seven-soldiers-killed-in-balochistan-blast (Al Jazeera English)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Twelve people are killed and 23 others are injured after a bus overturns in [[Padang Panjang]], [[West Sumatra]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://voi.id/en/news/480414 (VOI.ID)]
*Four people are killed and over 40 others are injured when a passenger bus rolls down into a gorge in [[Poonch District, India|Poonch District]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], India. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/four-dead-as-bus-falls-into-poonch-gorge/articleshow/120942188.cms (''The Times of India'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[India–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[United Kingdom|British]] [[Prime Minister of the UK|prime minister]] [[Keir Starmer]] and Indian [[Prime Minister of India|prime minister]] [[Narendra Modi]] announce they have signed a bilateral [[free trade agreement|free]] [[trade agreement]] to significantly lower [[tariff]]s on 99% of [[Foreign trade of India|Indian exports]] into the UK, including [[textile industry|textiles]], and halve tariffs of [[Foreign trade of the United Kingdom|British exports]] into India, including [[aerospace manufacturer|aerospace manufacturing]], [[whiskey]], and [[lamb meat]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/uk-india-cut-tariffs-on-whisky-textile-in-landmark-deal/a-72454355 (DW)]

'''Law and crime'''
*The [[government of Peru|government]] of [[Peru]] imposes a [[curfew]] and temporarily suspends [[gold mining]] in [[Pataz Province]] for 30 days after the bodies of thirteen [[miner]]s who were kidnapped and killed were discovered on Sunday. [https://www.dw.com/en/peru-suspends-gold-mining-in-north-after-massacre/a-72443414 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 German federal election]]
**The [[Bundestag]] elects [[Friedrich Merz]], [[Leader of the Christian Democratic Union|leader]] of the [[Christian Democratic Union of Germany|Christian Democratic Union]], as the 10th [[Chancellor of Germany|Chancellor]] of [[Germany]] in the second round of voting, with 325 votes out of the 316 votes necessary. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvgp22zlrgko (BBC News)] [https://www.tagesschau.de/kommentar/kanzlerwahl-merz-union-spd-100.html (Tagesschau)]
